title: minitrace v0.3.0 agent-session extensions
description: Constraints specific to agent-session traces. Per spec §13, a conformant trace validates against the base schema plus this type-specific schema; validating does not by itself make a trace conformant, since the schemas check a subset of the text.

turns.description: agent-session traces MUST have at least one turn (in contrast to judge-session traces, which MAY have an empty turns array).
